journal_lines: §aPetals in the air without any wind moving them. §oSmells sweet and close-grained, like clean sawdust and spring.§o Good §lCherry§l timber.
§aBlossoms falling the whole time I worked. Some landed on the cut and stayed there.
§aPale wood inside, close-grained, faintly sweet at the cut. Worth the trip.
§aA grove so quiet I worked quietly without meaning to.
§aPink in the canopy, pink on the ground, §opink in the fur by the time I left.§o Cherry everywhere.
§aRabbits under a low trunk. Worked around them. They didn't move.
§aThe smell of §lCherry§l wood at the cut stayed on the paws for a long time after.
§aPetals settled in the bag as I worked. Carried some home by accident. No complaints.
§aCut a single trunk and a soft sound came down with it. §oAll those petals at once.§o Stood still for a moment.
§aTook one tree. Left the rest standing. This place earns some restraint.
